transcript: Speaker A: ippol chirikkada, ippol ente English-ine kalakki chirikkanamada, it's only been 15 days on this app, now I can speak better English than you guys. [Laugh now, laugh at my English now, it's only been 15 days on this app, now I can speak better English than you guys.] Speaker B: Just 15 days? Wow, very fluent English! Speaker C: Adhe enna aap pannurathu? [Which app is that, bro?] Speaker A: SpeakX app, ithu AI English teaching app aanu, ithu nammal English padikkan help cheyyunnu. [SpeakX app, this is an AI English teaching app, it helps us learn English.] Speaker A: Ningal time waste cheythirunnappol njan daily 10-15 minute ee app-il English practice cheythirunnu. [While you guys were wasting time, I practiced English on this app for 10-15 minutes daily.] Speaker A: ithoru AI teacher aanu, samsarikkumbolo allenkil mistakes cheyyumbole enikku oru pedi illa, karanam enthu mistakes cheythalum ithu udane correct cheythu tharunnu. [This is an AI teacher, I have no fear when speaking or making mistakes, because whatever mistakes I make, it corrects them immediately.] Speaker A: Oru ee app-ilokkum. [Come, look at this app.] Speaker C: Hello ma'am, njangallum English samsarikkan padikkanu. [Hello ma'am, teach us to speak English too.] Speaker D: Sheri, ningalude free time-il ente koode English samsarikkan practice thudangoo. Rahul-inepole ningaludeyum English 15 muthal 20 divasathinullil fluent aayi maarum. [Sure, start practicing speaking English with me in your free time. Like Rahul, your English will also become fluent within 15 to 20 days.] Speaker B: Wow, Ee AI Teacher nallathallo, enikkum arshan pole English vedi. [Wow, this AI Teacher is good, I also want to speak English like Arshan.] Speaker A: Ee app jeevitham maatti, ippol ellavarum enikku respect thannundu, ningalum SpeakX download cheyyu. [This app changed my life, now everyone respects me, you too download SpeakX.]
